Admissions
Build your future here.
The University of West Florida offers plenty of room to explore. Our 1,600-acre campus is only a short drive from beautiful beaches and downtown Pensacola. Choose from more than 110 undergraduate and graduate programs and study what sparks your passion. Find your niche through any of our 130+ registered student organizations and 15 Division I athletic teams. Gain access to the resources and opportunities of a large university with small class sizes and personalized attention from world-renowned professors.
In short, everything you need for an unforgettable college experience happens here at UWF.
Begin your journey today.
Find out how and when to apply to UWF based on what type of student you will be.
Freshman
High school seniors or first-time-in-college students seeking an undergraduate degree.
Transfer
Students transferring with existing credits seeking an undergraduate degree.
Graduate
Those seeking a master's degree, doctorate or graduate certificate.
International
Non-U.S. citizens seeking an undergraduate or graduate degree.
Online
Those interested in earning an undergraduate or graduate degree online.
Continuing Education
Those seeking courses and programs for training, certification and professional advancement.
Visit Our Campus
Do more than just imagine the possibilities. Come see for yourself. Sit in on a class, take a tour of some of our state-of-the-art facilities and be sure to take a trip to the beach and dip your toes in the Gulf while you're here.

You Can Afford UWF
If you've got what it takes to be an Argo, we'll make tuition more affordable. Nearly 65% of students receive financial assistance, and 43% of our incoming Florida freshmen are eligible for free tuition coverage through our Argo 30 guarantee.
Tuition and Expenses
Apply for Aid

Military and Veterans
Recognized as a Gold-level Military Friendly® School in the large public school category and No. 6 Best Colleges for Veterans in the Regional South by U.S. News & World Report, the University of West Florida is dedicated to supporting our military and veteran students. The Office of Military Services and the Military & Veterans Transition Assistance Center can assist military students as they go through the admissions process and support them throughout their time at UWF.
